stories.title: Russian strike on Kyiv weapons depot kills 37
new_facts: Death toll revised to 37; strike part of 72 hours of near-constant drone attacks disrupting daily life.
Reveals this is the second Russian strike on an arms depot near Kyiv in under two months.
Confirms 37 killed and frames attack as third consecutive night of aerial assault.
New Russian attack on Bucha district near Kyiv killed at least 27 people.
Strike targeted a warehouse near Kyiv, causing huge fire/explosions; hundreds evacuated.
Russian drone strike hit a depot near Kyiv, killing at least 27 people and sparking fire/explosions.
stories.line: Russian strike on weapons depot near Kyiv kills at least 37 people in one of the deadliest attacks this year.

stories.title: Fed official signals resistance to Trump pressure on rates
new_facts: Links inflation stubbornness to Iran war reaching 6-month mark and Trump's tariff dispute with Canada
Frames Warsh's hawkish hint as putting the Fed on a collision course with Trump ahead of the midterms
stories.line: Federal Reserve official Kevin Warsh signals the central bank may resist Trump administration pressure on interest rates and tariffs.

stories.title: NASA prepares Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope for launch
new_facts: Telescope expected to survey hundreds of millions of stars and billions of galaxies.
Gives precise $4.3bn cost, notes telescope survived two rounds of budget cuts, and will search for exoplanets/planet formation clues.
Roman will test a coronagraph technology demo aimed at future Earthlike planet detection.
stories.line: NASA prepares to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a successor to Hubble designed to map dark energy and find exoplanets.
